+title: Filter evaluator and scoping arguments
+---
+## What
+Evaluate a filter against tasks, and connect it to the queries. The basis is plan.md §6.3.
+- `Sources/FoundationModelsKanban/Filter/FilterEvaluator.swift`: `#tag` (edges, markers, rename redirect, virtual tags), `@user` (actor slug or slug of the actor name), `^id` (the task itself or a `dependsOn` target, from edges and markers, by any short form or full URI), `%column` (column slug or slug of the column name). All matches ignore case. URL atoms resolve by key: the current key resolves in this board; a tag, actor, or column URL of a different board matches nothing; a URL of the wrong type, a board URL, or a comment URL gives `INVALID_FILTER`.
+- Scoping arguments of `tasks`: `tag` = `#x`, `assignee` = `@x`, `column` = `%x`, ANDed with `filter`.
+- `excludeDone`: with no value, `true`; `false` when a column is named by `column`, a `%` atom, or a column URL.
+- Connect `filter` to `Board.tasks`, `Board.nextTask` (not done, ready, matches; sort by column order then ordinal), and the `tasks` fields of `Column`, `Actor`, `Tag`.
+
+## Acceptance Criteria
+- [ ] Each filter example in the Rust kanban tool description (`../swissarmyhammer/crates/swissarmyhammer-tools/src/mcp/tools/kanban/description.md`) and in `../skills/skills/kanban/SKILL.md` and `../skills/skills/finish/SKILL.md` gives the same tasks as in Rust, except `$project`, which gives `INVALID_FILTER`.
+- [ ] `%done` lists done tasks; `%review || (%todo && #READY)` gives the tasks of both parts.
+- [ ] An `id` copied from a query result works as a filter.
+
+## Tests
+- [ ] `Tests/FoundationModelsKanbanTests/Filter/FilterEvaluatorTests.swift` (port the evaluator tests of `swissarmyhammer-filter-expr`) and `FilterCompatibilityTests.swift` (the description and skill examples).
+- [ ] Run `swift test --filter Filter`; expect all pass.
+
+## Workflow
+- Use `/tdd` — write failing tests first, then implement to make them pass.
\ No newline at end of file
